+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql/driver"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger implements database connection checks for SQL Server.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping logs in and runs a simple query through the SQL Server protocol.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid Port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	connector.Dialer = sqlServerDialer{ctx: ctx}
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer conn.Close()
+	err = conn.(driver.Pinger).Ping(ctx)
+	if ctx.Err() != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+	}
+	return trace.Wrap(err)
+}
+
+// sqlServerDialer makes login reads obey the ping context as well as dialing.
+type sqlServerDialer struct{ ctx context.Context }
+
+func (d sqlServerDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	var dialer net.Dialer
+	conn, err := dialer.DialContext(ctx, network, address)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if deadline, ok := d.ctx.Deadline(); ok {
+		if err := conn.SetDeadline(deadline); err != nil {
+			conn.Close()
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+	bound := &sqlServerContextConn{Conn: conn, done: make(chan struct{})}
+	go func() {
+		select {
+		case <-d.ctx.Done():
+			bound.Close()
+		case <-bound.done:
+		}
+	}()
+	return bound, nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerContextConn struct {
+	net.Conn
+	done chan struct{}
+	once sync.Once
+}
+
+func (c *sqlServerContextConn) Close() error {
+	c.once.Do(func() { close(c.done) })
+	return c.Conn.Close()
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether the server refused the TCP connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports a SQL Server login failure.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err) == 18456
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports a missing or inaccessible database.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	return sqlServerErrorNumber(err) == 4060
+}
+
+func sqlServerErrorNumber(err error) int32 {
+	var sqlErr interface{ SQLErrorNumber() int32 }
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		return sqlErr.SQLErrorNumber()
+	}
+	return 0
+}

+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	tests := []struct {
+		name                string
+		err                 error
+		connectionRefused   bool
+		invalidDatabaseUser bool
+		invalidDatabaseName bool
+	}{
+		{name: "nil"},
+		{name: "refused", err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.ECONNREFUSED), connectionRefused: true},
+		{name: "wrapped login failure", err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 18456}), invalidDatabaseUser: true},
+		{name: "database unavailable", err: fmt.Errorf("login: %w", mssql.Error{Number: 4060}), invalidDatabaseName: true},
+		{name: "other server error", err: mssql.Error{Number: 208}},
+		{name: "unrelated error", err: errors.New("invalid user")},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tt.connectionRefused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.invalidDatabaseUser, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.invalidDatabaseName, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tt.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() { _ = server.Serve() }()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { server.Close() })
+
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, p.Ping(ctx, PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingValidationAndDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, params := range []PingParams{
+		{Port: 1433, DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Port: 1433, Username: "user"},
+		{Port: -1, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+		{Port: 65536, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"},
+	} {
+		require.Error(t, p.Ping(context.Background(), params))
+	}
+
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			defer conn.Close()
+			<-time.After(time.Second)
+		}
+	}()
+	port := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	start := time.Now()
+	err = p.Ping(ctx, PingParams{Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: port, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"})
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Less(t, time.Since(start), time.Second)
+}
